Date: Wed, 24 Jun 2026 16:12:00 +0100
Subject: Condense QBR and regional windows?

Hi Karthik / Marissa,

Thanks again for the steady cadence — were approaching our renewal QBR and the exec team wants to keep it tight this cycle. Two asks from our side:

1) Can we compress the roadmap demo into a regional, condensed cadence rather than one global 2.5hr session? Specifically: a 90-minute US/EMEA session and a separate 60-minute APAC session the following week.

2) Wed like to limit live exec attendees (3–4) but still have a technical backup present for questions. Can Redwood provide a documented backup presenter list and a short run-of-show so we can confirm who joins live vs whos on standby?

If you can send a proposed schedule and a single-page run-of-show, Ill get this in front of the execs today. Also – any constraints around recording access? Security wants recordings limited to named accounts.

Attached: example agenda from last year (for reference).

Best,
Anita
Director, Customer Success
VelaHealth

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>

Hi Anita — thanks for the clear asks. Short version: yes, we can do the condensed approach and well provide the run-of-show + backup presenter matrix.

Proposal (high level):
- US/EMEA compact session: 90 minutes (roadmap 35, product demo 30, customer highlights 10, 15 min for live Q&A + fallback)
- APAC compact session (separate day): 60 minutes (roadmap 30, demo 15, 15 mins Q&A)

Well limit the live exec roster to 3 names per your note; well include a named technical standby who can jump in for question routing. Marissa will own the run-of-show; Soojin will be our tech backup and manage the rehearsal/recording permissions.

Attached Im sharing a draft run-of-show (run_of_show_v1.pdf) and a lightweight attendee matrix (attendee_matrix.csv). Can you review the attendee cap and confirm that the EMEA session should be prioritized for your execs (we can stage APAC a week later)?

On recording: we can gate recording access to specific Redwood accounts and share a link only to whitelisted emails. So if Vela wants recordings restricted to named accounts, please send the list or confirm whether the security group (security@velahealth.com) should be granted access. Note: we need those emails before the dry-run to set the ACL.

Next steps:
- Anita: confirm attendee cap + whether the EMEA slot is primary
- Vela security: list of whitelisted addresses (or confirm security@velahealth.com)
- Redwood: schedule two dry-runs (short tech check + full run) — suggest Thurs/ Fri next week; well propose concrete slots once you confirm region priority.

Thanks —
Karthik Iyer
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference

Attachments: run_of_show_v1.pdf (one-page), attendee_matrix.csv
